title: room.resumed
description: server → host and clients. Confirms the resume. The snapshot follows. The token stays the same.

id.description: The literal "host" for the host, else a PlayerId or a SpectatorId.

slot.description: Seat number for players; null otherwise.

pendingPlayer.description: Spectators only: still waiting to be promoted. False otherwise.

paused.description: True when the game is paused at the time of the resume.

PlayerId.description: Player identifier, unique within a room and never reused: "p" followed by a positive integer (p1, p2, …).

RoomCode.description: Room code: exactly 4 upper-case letters from A–Z without I and O (24-letter alphabet). Clients upper-case user input before sending.

SpectatorId.description: Spectator identifier, unique within a room and never reused: "s" followed by a positive integer.
